mapper.select:
SELECT PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECNAME, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECFULLNAME, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECCODE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.MARKET, PAYHSRCSECINFO.INSTITUTION, PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUEPRICE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.PUBENDDATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.VDATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.MDATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUEAMT, CUSTOMER_INFO1.CUSTOMER_NAME issuerName, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECTYPE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECTYPE2, CASE PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUETYPE WHEN '01' THEN '1' ELSE '2' END AS ISSUETYPE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.BLNAREA, PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUS, PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSECBOND, PAYHSRCSECINFO.CITY_INVEST_SEC_CHB CITYINVESTSECWIND, PAYHSRCSECINFO.CCY, PAYHSRCSECINFO.FACEVALUE, CUSTOMER_INFO2.CUSTOMER_NAME WARRANTOR, PAYHSRCSECINFO.GUARTYPE, CASE
WHEN ( PAYHSRCSECINFO.CALLOPTION = 'Y' OR PAYHSRCSECINFO.PUTOPTION = 'Y' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IS_RIGHT, PAYHSRCSECINFO.REMARK, PAYHSRCSECINFO.COUPONSPECIES, PAYHSRCSECINFO.INTERESTRATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.PAPERIR, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SPREADRATE_8 SPREADRATE8, PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATECODE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.COEFFICIENT, PAYHSRCSECINFO.TOPRATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.BOTTOMRATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.RESETTYPE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.OBSERVEBEFDAY, PAYHSRCSECINFO.OBSERVEBEFUNIT, CASE
WHEN ( PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = 'A/A_B_COUP' OR PAYHSRCSECINFO.PUTOPTION = 'A_B_DAY' ) THEN 'A/A' ELSE PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC END AS RATEBASIC, CASE
WHEN PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = 'A/A_B_COUP' THEN '02' WHEN PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = 'A/A_B_DAY' THEN '01' END AS BASISSTYLE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.WORKDAYRULE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.PAYCYCLE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SCHECALRULE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.FIRSTRATEDAY FROM INTERF_PAYHSRCSECINFO PAYHSRCSECINFO LEFT JOIN INTERF_CUSTOMER_INFO CUSTOMER_INFO1 ON PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUERSHORT = CUSTOMER_INFO1.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN INTERF_CUSTOMER_INFO CUSTOMER_INFO2 ON CUSTOMER_INFO1.CUSTOMER_ID = PAYHSRCSECINFO.GUARANTOR LEFT JOIN INTERF_PAYHSRCSECOPTION PAYHSRCSECOPTION ON PAYHSRCSECOPTION.SECID = PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID LEFT JOIN INTERF_PAYHSRCSECRATING PAYHSRCSECRATING ON PAYHSRCSECRATING.SECID = PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID AND PAYHSRCSECRATING.ratingtype = 'C' LEFT JOIN INTERF_PAYHSRCSECRATING PAYHSRCSECRATING2 ON PAYHSRCSECRATING2.SECID = PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID AND PAYHSRCSECRATING2.ratingtype = 'I'
PAYHSRCSECINFO.VDATE <= to_date ( #{iplatformDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD' )
AND PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID = #{secId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select SECID, OPTIONSTARTDAY, OPTIONENDDAY, OPTIONPAYDAY, THEORYOPTIONPAYDAY, OPTIONPRICE, OPTIONTYPE, OPTIONCLAUSE from INTERF_PAYHSRCSECOPTION where SECID = #{secId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY THEORYOPTIONPAYDAY ASC

SELECT PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECNAME, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECFULLNAME, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECCODE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.MARKET, PAYHSRCSECINFO.INSTITUTION, PAYHSRCSECINFO.INSTITUTIONTEXT, PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUEPRICE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.PUBENDDATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.VDATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.MDATE, CASE WHEN PAYHSRCSECINFO.摘牌日 IS NOT NULL THEN PAYHSRCSECINFO.摘牌日 WHEN (PAYHSRCSECINFO.CALLOPTION = 'Y' OR PAYHSRCSECINFO.PUTOPTION = 'Y') AND MARKET_INFO.MARKET_AMT = 0 THEN MARKET_INFO.VALUE_DATE ELSE PAYHSRCSECINFO.MDATE as 摘牌日, PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUEAMT, PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUERSHORT ISSUERNAME, CASE WHEN PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUETYPE = '01' THEN '公募' WHEN PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUETYPE = '02' THEN '私募' ELSE '' END AS ISSUETYPE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUS, CASE WHEN (PAYHSRCSECINFO.CALLOPTION = 'Y' OR PAYHSRCSECINFO.PUTOPTION = 'Y') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ISRIGHT, 'Y' ISAUTOUPDATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.是否净价交易, PAYHSRCSECINFO.CCY, CASE WHEN PAYHSRCSECINFO.CITY_INVEST_SEC_WIND = 'Y' AND (PAYHSRCSECINFO.是否绿色债 != 'Y' OR PAYHSRCSECINFO.是否绿色债 IS NULL) THEN CITYINVESTSECWIND WHEN PAYHSRCSECINFO.是否绿色债 = 'Y' AND (PAYHSRCSECINFO.CITY_INVEST_SEC_WIND != 'Y' OR PAYHSRCSECINFO.CITY_INVEST_SEC_WIND IS NULL) THEN 绿色债 WHEN PAYHSRCSECINFO.CITY_INVEST_SEC_WIND = 'Y' AND PAYHSRCSECINFO.是否绿色债 = 'Y' THEN 城投债, 绿色债 ELSE NULL END AS 概念标识, PAYHSRCSECINFO.跨市场代码, PAYHSRCSECINFO.REMARK, --转债信息 PAYHSRCSECINFO.正股代码, PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR SHARENAME, PAYHSRCSECINFO.转股起始日, PAYHSRCSECINFO.转股价格, PAYHSRCSECINFO.回售触发价, PAYHSRCSECINFO.赎回触发价, --计息要素 PAYHSRCSECINFO.COUPONSPECIES, PAYHSRCSECINFO.INTERESTRATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.PAPERIR, PAYHSRCSECINFO.基准利率精度, PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATECODE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.COEFFICIENT, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SPREADRATE_8 SPREADRATE8, PAYHSRCSECINFO.TOPRATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.BOTTOMRATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.RESETTYPE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.OBSERVEBEFDAY, PAYHSRCSECINFO.OBSERVEBEFUNIT, PAYHSRCSECINFO.首次利率确定日, CASE WHEN PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = 'A/365' THEN 'A/365' WHEN PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = 'A/360' THEN 'A/360' WHEN PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = 'A/365F' THEN 'A/365F' WHEN PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = '30/360' THEN '30/360' WHEN (PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = 'A/A_B_COUP' OR PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = 'A/A_B_DAY') THEN 'A/A' ELSE NULL END AS RATEBASIC, CASE WHEN PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = 'A/A_B_COUP' THEN '平均分配' WHEN PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = 'A/A_B_DAY' THEN '按实际天数分配' ELSE NULL END AS BASICSTYLE, --付息信息 PAYHSRCSECINFO.WORKDAYRULE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.PAYCYCLE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SCHECALRULE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.FIRSTRATEDAY --付息计划 PAYHSRCSECSCHEDULE.INTERESTSTARTDAY, PAYHSRCSECSCHEDULE.INTERESTENDDAY, PAYHSRCSECSCHEDULE.COUPONRATE, PAYHSRCSECSCHEDULE.PRINAMT, PAYHSRCSECSCHEDULE.ACCRUEINTAMT, --还本计划 PAYHSRCSECSCHEDULE2.INTERESTENDDAY, PAYHSRCSECSCHEDULE2.PRINAMTPAY, PAYHSRCSECSCHEDULE2.ACCRUEINTAMT, PAYHSRCSECSCHEDULE2.CASHPAY --行权计划 PAYHSRCSECSCHEDULE2.OPTIONSTARTDAY, PAYHSRCSECSCHEDULE2.OPTIONENDDAY, PAYHSRCSECSCHEDULE2.OPTIONTYPE, PAYHSRCSECSCHEDULE2.THEORYOPTIONPAYDAY, PAYHSRCSECSCHEDULE2.OPTIONPAYDAY, PAYHSRCSECSCHEDULE2.OPTIONPRICE, PAYHSRCSECSCHEDULE2.OPTIONCLAUSE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.REMARK REMARK FROM INTERF_PAYHSRCSECINFO PAYHSRCSECINFO LEFT JOIN INTERF_PAYHSRCSECSCHEDULE PAYHSRCSECSCHEDULE ON PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID = PAYHSRCSECSCHEDULE.SECID AND PAYHSRCSECSCHEDULE.SCHEDUTYPE IN ('01', '04') LEFT JOIN INTERF_PAYHSRCSECSCHEDULE PAYHSRCSECSCHEDULE2 ON PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID = PAYHSRCSECSCHEDULE2.SECID AND PAYHSRCSECSCHEDULE2.SCHEDUTYPE IN ('02', '03'); LEFT JOIN INTERF_PAYHSRCSECOPTION PAYHSRCSECOPTION ON PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID = PAYHSRCSECOPTION.SECID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT PRODUCT ON PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = PAYHSRCSECINFO.正股代码 AND PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F10' LEFT JOIN MST_BOND_MARKET_INFO MARKET_INFO ON MARKET_INFO.SECID = PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID AND MARKET_INFO.VALUE_DATE <= to_date(#{sysDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd') WHERE PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID = #{secId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
